brand.name: SUPERAGENT
brand.one_liner: AI that helps US insurance agencies answer the phone and book the work they already paid to generate.

pages.excerpt: SUPERAGENT helps insurance agencies adopt AI. Owners stop missing inbound calls. The agency keeps the conversation.
Founded by Vadym Shashkov. Built for independent and captive US insurance agencies, not consumers shopping for a policy.
An AI agent that answers agency phones, books appointments, and follows up when a producer is out.

nodes.text: AI phone agent that answers inbound agency calls and books the appointment
Owners and sales leaders at independent and captive US insurance agencies with 1 to 10 producers
Not consumers shopping for a policy, and not carriers
Inbound calls go to voicemail when the desk is busy. Paid leads die in the queue.
Put an AI agent on the agency phone so a person still owns the book of business
Built for insurance agencies, not a generic AI SDR that cold-emails a B2B list

insights.title: What they keep repeating
insights.observation: Smith.ai and Ruby keep selling a generic receptionist. Never miss a call. A real person every time.
insights.recommendation: Talk to the agency owner mid-missed-call. Do not copy the horizontal receptionist hook.

insights.title: What has stayed up
insights.observation: Smith and Ruby receptionist cards have been up for months. Longevity, not performance.
insights.recommendation: Keep the insurance-agency claim if the site still stands behind it.

insights.title: A gap we can own
insights.observation: Nobody in the set talks to a 1-to-10 producer agency that already paid for the lead.
insights.recommendation: Write the ChatGPT card from the missed inbound call, not from a generic SDR hook.
